top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs two non-overlapping achievements, each with a one-sentence principle and a new capability: base editing (Liu alone), the programmable deamination of a single nucleobase without a double-strand break, and targeted protein degradation (Crews and Deshaies), event-driven removal of a protein by induced proximity to an E3 ligase, conceived and first demonstrated in 2001. Both are reproduced by many independent groups, and the allocation stays at three names with clean citations that do not depend on a drug approval. P003 follows because it keeps Liu and swaps in the more mature C-N coupling. P005 is next because it keeps the PROTAC concept and adds Ciulli, whose structure-guided ligands made degraders a rational chemical series. P004 is the mature but narrower single-achievement prize. P002 ranks below these because it folds the cereblon mechanism-of-action discovery into the same citation, which stretches one citation across two achievements. A prize is still preferable to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; I share a Lund affiliation with Somfai and Sparr, but no credited laureate in any proposal is connected to Lund or to my work on molecular motors and nanodevices
